neha: Quick sync 10Cloud (SI) + NanoChip (HW) want marketplace listing 2024-06-15. Legal asked: exact artifact list and upload flow for SOC/pen/firmware. Who owns presigns?
emily: Security: need SOC2 PDF or bridge letter, third-party pen report with CVSS & remediation notes, firmware-attest.pdf (signed), SBOM (SPDX or CSV), and questionnaire.md. Raw findings -> passworded zip to secure intake.
tom: NanoChip can sign firmware PDF and produce build_provenance.txt with commit SHA. Notarization possible but will add ~5 business days.
neha: Partnerships will issue presigned PUTs to s3://rw-marketplace-partner-ingest/{partner}/{listing}/. Default TTL 7d, can do 3d on request. We'll use alias/marketplace-ingest-prod for SSE-KMS.
kevin: Ops Q: partners want client-side encryption sometimes. We support envelope CSE; partner must provide KMS thumbprint for decryption. Also please include x-amz-meta-build-hash on objects.
emily: Public listing only gets redacted-summary.pdf. Security reviews full artifacts in presigned bucket; password for zips sent OOB. Pen vendors must provide signed scope + proof of test dates.
neha: I'll own presign generation and checklist. Expected rough uploads: firmware+sbom by 2024-05-10, SOC draft by 2024-05-12, pen draft by 2024-05-14. I'll post presigned links here when ready.
ingest-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/partner-ingest (see section 3: firmware & provenance).
